uid.description: Optional client-chosen UUID for the note id. Kept when free. A UID of a note the caller can see is a 409 (a retry into the same notebook returns that note). Any other taken UID, or a value that is not a UUID, is replaced by a server-minted UUID: the response id is authoritative.

categories.description: Replace the whole tag set. Create uses this, and so does an explicit replace. Tag edits use categoriesAdd and categoriesRemove. Archive, star, and notebook move omit this field. Do not combine this field with either delta field.

categoriesAdd.description: Tags to add onto the set stored in the journal. Applied after categoriesRemove, on the locked row. A new tag uses the same rule as categories. Do not send with categories.

categoriesRemove.description: Tags to remove from the set stored in the journal, before categoriesAdd. An invalid or stale tag is allowed so it can always be removed. Do not send with categories.

NoteCollaborativePut.description: JSON header inside the framed collaborative save. The HTTP body is application/octet-stream: a uint16 big-endian header length, this JSON object, then the markdown bytes, then the Yjs bytes. A null length omits that block. Notes require both blocks.

documentLen.description: Byte length of the markdown block. Null omits it.

yjsLen.description: Byte length of the Yjs block. Null omits it. Rejected with 413 above 5 MiB.

title.description: SUMMARY projection. Omit it when the document has not adopted a title, so a body save does not clear SUMMARY.
